title: fix(spec): a page component's visibleWhen names no `data` root — the shipping renderer mounts none
body:
Fixes #23036
Clause-②: no

The `visibleWhen` describe on `PageComponentSchema` and the 「Ambient roots」 docblock above it now name only what the shipping renderer mounts. They say that no `data` root is mounted on this surface, as objectstack-ai/objectui#9308 ruling B left it. ⛔ No `data` root is bound or refused in code, no accept set moves, and there is no renderer change. Text only, plus pins, the regenerated reference page, and a patch changeset.

Spelling note: the schema text writes page state as `page.` followed by a variable name in angle brackets. That fragment does not survive a GitHub body, so it is written `page.VAR` below.

## What the renderer mounts (the readings the new text states)

All readings are at objectui `origin/main` `f228d710`. The four evaluator files (`SchemaRenderer.tsx`, `ExpressionProvider.tsx`, `hooks/useExpression.ts`, `containers.tsx`) are byte-identical at the `.objectui-sha` pin `1fb1ced36243` (`diff` of each file at the two commits: identical).

- **The page component's evaluator.** `packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:665-676` (`configEvaluationScope`) builds `{ ...predicateScope, current_user: predicateScope.user, record (only when a row is bound), page }`. The memo builds this surface's evaluator from it (`:1228-1229`), and the `visibleWhen` leg calls `evaluator.evaluateCondition` on that evaluator (`:1319`, the production branch). No `data` key. The decision is written at `:1194`: "⛔ `data` is NOT here, and the absence is the decision (objectui#9308, maintainer ruling 2026-09-13 option B)".
- **The ambient scope, which is the predicate-scope channel.** `predicateScope` is `usePredicateScope()`, fed through `PredicateScopeProvider`. In the console its only production feeder is app-shell's `ExpressionProvider`: `git grep PredicateScopeProvider` over `packages/*/src` finds one non-test provider mount, `ExpressionProvider.tsx:306`. Its `buildExpressionScope` (`ExpressionProvider.tsx:181-190`) returns `{ current_user, user, ctx: { user }, os: { user }, features }`. So `features` and `os.user` are mounted, and `data` is not.
- **A `page:tabs` item's `visibleWhen`.** This is a separate evaluator, `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:642-649`. It spreads the row's bare fields, spreads `predicateScope`, and binds `current_user`, `record: row`, `data: row` and `page`. The old "record ROW" sentence is still true, so it stays.
- **What a `data.*` gate does on the component.** `ExpressionEvaluator.evaluateCondition` (`packages/core/src/evaluator/ExpressionEvaluator.ts:341` onward) answers a faulting predicate with the fail-soft `true`, and the SHOW leg negates that into "not hidden". So the component renders whether the predicate is true or false. This matches the card's measurement through `SchemaRenderer` at `d758f2f2` (`data.total > 0` and `data.total == 0` both SHOWN).
- **The planned API binding.** objectstack-ai/objectui#12197 (the renderer half of `provider: 'api'`) is open. `isElementDataSourceConfig` (`packages/core/src/data-scope/element-data-source.ts:169`) still admits only a plain object with a string `object`. No renderer reads the API binding today.

## Each changed sentence, FROM → TO

### `PageComponentSchema.visibleWhen` `.describe()` (published; republished into `content/docs/references/ui/page.mdx`)

The sentences before and after these are unchanged ("Visibility predicate (CEL) … only when TRUE.", "Contract-bound roots: …", and the closing `e.g.` example).

- FROM: "The shipping renderer additionally mounts `features`, `os.user` and binds `data` to the data-source ADAPTER here — renderer behaviour, NOT contract-guaranteed (ADR-0068 rules the user object only)."
  TO: "The shipping renderer additionally mounts `features` and `os.user` — renderer behaviour, NOT contract-guaranteed (ADR-0068 rules the user object only). It mounts NO `data` root here: a `data.*` read faults and a faulting predicate renders the component, so such a gate never gates; the page's row is `record`."
  Backed by: `configEvaluationScope`, `buildExpressionScope` and `evaluateCondition` above.
- NEW: "`data` is declared only for an element whose `dataSource` is the PLANNED API binding (`provider: 'api'`), which reads its bound value as `data` once that binding's renderer ships."
  Backed by: the `provider: 'api'` describe (`page.zod.ts:502`, unchanged) and objectui#12197 still open.
- FROM: "⚠️ `data` is surface-dependent: on a `page:tabs` item `visibleWhen` it is the record ROW instead."
  TO: "⚠️ A `page:tabs` item `visibleWhen` is a different evaluator: it binds `data` to the record ROW."
  Backed by: `containers.tsx:642-649`.

### The TSDoc docblock above `visibleWhen` (read by whoever opens the file)

- 「Ambient roots」 FROM: "The shipping renderer additionally mounts `features` and `os.user` from app-shell's `ExpressionProvider`, and binds `data`."
  TO: "… from app-shell's `ExpressionProvider`." The rest of the paragraph (no ADR rules those roots on this surface) is unchanged.
- Measurement line FROM: pin `190fbd01d061` and objectui `f2732afe`, `ExpressionProvider.tsx:59`, `SchemaRenderer.tsx:463-471`.
  TO: pin `1fb1ced36243` and objectui `f228d710`, `ExpressionProvider.tsx:181-190` (`buildExpressionScope`: `current_user`, `user`, `ctx.user`, `os.user`, `features`, and nothing else), and `SchemaRenderer.tsx:665-676` (`configEvaluationScope`, adding `record` when the page has a row, and `page`).
- Section FROM: "⚠️ `data` is surface-dependent. HERE `data` is the data-source ADAPTER — what `${data.total}` in a `properties` / `props` / `content` value interpolates against. On a `page:tabs` item-level `visibleWhen` a separate evaluator (`containers.tsx:450-457`) binds `data` to the record ROW instead. Same key name, two bindings; …"
  TO: two sections.
  - "No `data` root on this surface": ruling B removed `data` as a runtime expression root (`SchemaRenderer.tsx:1194`). A data scope reaches a predicate only through the predicate-scope channel, whose one shipping feeder publishes no `data`. So a `data.*` read faults and the component renders in both polarities. The row is `record`. Then: the one `data` this surface declares is the PLANNED API binding's, read once that binding's renderer ships, and no element has a `data` to read today.
  - "⚠️ A `page:tabs` item is a different evaluator": `containers.tsx:642-649` binds `data` to the row and spreads the row's bare fields. That is a binding this surface does not have.
  - The `${data.total}` interpolation claim is dropped, not reworded. `properties` values are evaluated by the same `configEvaluationScope` evaluator, so `data` does not resolve there either.

### How the two texts agree (dispatch assumption A3)

`page.zod.ts:502` (unchanged) says the PLANNED API binding "binds the selected value, which the element reads as `data` in its expression holes and its `visibleWhen`". The new `visibleWhen` text makes both statements true together. Today no `data` root is mounted. A `data` read exists only on an element that carries the API binding, and only once that binding's renderer ships. `:502` did not have to change, so there is no open question. The new pin holds the agreement: it goes red if the API binding's describe loses its `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` marker while this text still calls it planned.

## Verification record

Every reading below is at head `8f64f1ae3` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`), which is `f43d856ca` plus `96b07ccb9` plus a merge of `origin/main` `dfb3ba2b2`. The merge touched no file in `packages/spec`.

- **Pins.** New `packages/spec/src/ui/expression-scope-data-root.pin.test.ts`. It checks six things:
  - the mounted-roots sentence names exactly `features` and `os.user`, on both faces;
  - each published sentence that names `data` is one of the three true readings (not mounted, PLANNED binding, `page:tabs`);
  - the two shapes the retired claim was written in are absent;
  - the `page:tabs` row reading survives;
  - the contract-bound roots survive;
  - the PLANNED agreement with `ElementApiDataSourceSchema`'s describe holds.

  DARK controls run the classifier over the replaced sentence and require it to fail. They also prove the splitter keeps dotted tokens together, and that a missing anchor throws. The existing `expression-scope-app-root.pin.test.ts` drops its two `data` survival controls (`toContain('`data`')` on the describe, `toContain('binds `data`')` on the docblock), and its `app` assertions are unchanged.
- **Red first.** I committed the fix, wrote BASE `bcebd8409`'s `page.zod.ts` to disk under a `trap … EXIT INT TERM` restore, and ran the new pin. On-disk proof: retired-claim grep 1, new-claim grep 0, blob `7519cc64` against HEAD blob `62efbb6f`. Result: `Tests  5 failed | 6 passed (11)`. The five red assertions are both mounted-roots sentences (`expected [ 'features', 'os.user', 'data' ] to deeply equal [ 'features', 'os.user' ]`), both absence assertions, and the PLANNED-binding sentence. Restore was proved by blob `62efbb6f` equal to the HEAD blob and an empty `git diff HEAD`. `git status --porcelain` was empty afterwards.
- **Spec suite, both projects.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project local --project repo --maxWorkers=2` reported `Test Files  717 passed (717)` and `Tests  20995 passed | 1 todo (20996)`, with VERDICT command-exit 0.
- **Generated artifacts.** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, then `check:generated` named exactly one stale artifact (`content/docs/references/ui/page.mdx`, two rows). After `gen:docs`, the re-run printed `✓ All 14 generated artifacts are up to date`.
- **Gate families.** I derived them with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `8f64f1ae3`: 109 commands. All except `pnpm check:type-check-debt` were run, which is NOT MEASURED by this dispatch's order. Each exit was captured before any pipe. Results: 102 exit 0 on the first pass. Six exited 3 with `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` because unbuilt packages meant nothing was measured: `@objectstack/lint` `check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:doc-security-posture`, spec `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`. After building the `@objectstack/lint...`, `@objectstack/objectql...` and `@objectstack/client-react...` closures, the first five re-ran exit 0. Then I built the rest of the workspace (`turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs`, 74 tasks, 35 cached), and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` re-ran exit 0: `108 published require entry point(s) across 67 package(s) load`. `--ran` reconciliation over the final record (every line carries its exit code): `109 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 108 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (0 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3, 1 claimed)`. The one claimed is `check:type-check-debt`, by order. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exited 0. Both pin files are in `tsconfig.test.json`'s program (`tsc --listFilesOnly`, counted).
- **Lint.** The `os validate` reading for dispatch assumption A4 is under Acceptance notes.
- **Not run locally, declared narrowing.** `turbo ls --affected` names 82 packages: `@objectstack/spec` and every dependent. This diff changes `.describe()` and TSDoc text in one spec file and nothing else in any package. No export, type, accept set or wire shape moves (`check:api-surface` and `check:authorable-surface` are green). `git grep` for the old and new sentences outside `packages/spec/src` finds only the regenerated reference page and this PR's changeset. So the spec package's own suite is what this change can move. The other 81 packages' suites are CI's Test Core. Blind spot, stated with that claim: `turbo ls --affected` comes from the package dependency graph, so it cannot see a test that reads another package's source from disk. `check:cross-package-test-inputs` is green, with every such read declared. The repo-root suites are not on the graph.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/23036-visiblewhen-no-data-root.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, `Clause-②: no`. `check-adr-0087-registration` reads it as non-breaking, so no marker is owed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Assumption A4, corrected rule name.** The rule that answers a `data.`-rooted page-component predicate is `visibility-root-mislayered` (severity `warning`), not `visibility-bare-identifier`. `data` is in `@objectstack/formula`'s `SCOPE_ROOTS`, so the bare-identifier rule never fires on it. Reading: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-visibility-predicates.test.ts` filtered to the page-component and layer cases gave `48 passed | 148 skipped`. That covers "a PAGE COMPONENT predicate is still read through the page-side `visibility` key" and "resolves predicates stored as `{ dialect, source }` envelopes", both `[VISIBILITY_ROOT_MISLAYERED]` on `data.x`. The rule's runtime message already says such a predicate "never matches and the element always renders", which agrees with the new describe. No lint change is owed.
- **Same-family residue outside this claim's file surface (not changed here).** `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts:994-995`, in the TSDoc of the `page:tabs` item `visibleWhen`, says "`data` is the record ROW here, where the component-node evaluator binds it to the data-source ADAPTER". The second half is the claim this PR retires. The same docblock cites `containers.tsx:450-457` at pin `190fbd01d061`; the lines are `642-649` at `1fb1ced36243`. The published describe at `:1017` ("binds `data` to the record ROW (not the data-source adapter)") is still true. The claim's file surface names `page.zod.ts` only, so I stopped at that fence. Suggested text for whoever carries it: "**`data` is the record ROW here**; the component-node evaluator mounts no `data` root at all (see `PageComponentSchema.visibleWhen`)". Its pin would be one more TSDoc face in `expression-scope-data-root.pin.test.ts`.
- **A stale code comment in `@objectstack/lint`.** `packages/lint/src/validate-visibility-predicates.ts:343` records a measurement "a page component additionally `page` and the data-source adapter `data`". The argument it supports still holds, because `data` is in `SCOPE_ROOTS` either way. Comment only, with no author-visible reach. Carrier: none.
- **For the API binding's renderer (objectui#12197).** Under ruling B, `SchemaRenderer` binds no `data` of its own. So the planned `data` read in an element's `visibleWhen` has one existing way in, the predicate-scope channel, which ruling B left un-shadowed for exactly this. This is an observation for that card's carrier, not a decision made here.
- **Labels.** Zero label writes: this dispatch's write budget names none.
